text:
tara: FYI we need a lightweight docs runbook for the v1 -> v2 deprecation targeted at integrators and partners. Scope: 1) one-line site banner, 2) single-page migration guide, 3) side-by-side snippets (py/ts/go), 4) model mapping note (embed dims), 5) redirects + automation, 6) PR template with smoke checklist. Deadline: 2025-05-30 AM. Who takes which piece?
phil: I can own the PR template and the GH action that runs a link-check + redirect-check. Will add labels: docs-deprecate, needs-smoke, redirect-needed. Template will require: summary, list of files modified, smoke test artifact URL, redirect entries, and a short migration impact note.
nana: (typo fix) -- ana: I'll draft the migration one-pager and the model mapping section. Plan to include a tiny "impact matrix" and clear advice for embedding vector dimension changes and reindexing vs. alias fallback.
sylvia: I'll prepare language snippets and a short compatibility shim. Important to call out the API rename: `client.models.invoke` -> `client.responses.create` and the input shape change from a single string to an array of role/content items. Also update streaming examples to reflect SSE event renames.
docs-bot: automation note: once model-mapping doc lands we can auto-generate redirect PRs for /v1/* -> mapped /v2/* pages. If a /v1/* page has no mapping, we add a banner on that page requiring manual review. Suggest CI job fail unless unmapped /v1/* pages are explicitly acknowledged in the PR.
tara: Good. Some concrete snippets for the guide:
```python
# v1 (old)
resp = client.models.invoke("gpt-redwood-01", input="hi")
# v2 (new)
resp = client.responses.create(model="gpt-redwood-01", input=[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}])
# short compat shim (temporary)
def invoke_v1_compat(client, model_id, text):
    return client.responses.create(model=model_id, input=[{"role":"user","content": text}])
```
sylvia: For streaming: old SSE events `event: chunk` and `event: done` are now `event: response.delta` and `event: response.complete`. I'll add a small example and run the staging smoke harness to verify event names.
nana: Model mapping example (one-row): `old-embed-512 -> redwood-embed-1024` with note: "vector dimension change; recommended action: reindex vectors for best accuracy. Temporary alias fallback available for up to 30 days; re-rank differences may occur." Will add a short 'what breaks' list.
phil: PR template checklist I'll commit under /.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/docs_deprecation.md and wire a GH action to auto-label PRs touching /docs/** with docs-deprecate. The checklist will also prompt authors to paste smoke test output (link) and to list redirect entries in a simple YAML table in the PR body.
tara: Banner copy (one line) suggestion: "Deprecation: v1 API will be retired on 2025-06-01. See migration guide." Short and linkable. We'll use that for the global header and as a fallback banner on unmapped pages.
sylvia: I'll produce py/ts/go snippet pairs and mark any temporary shim as "not recommended for long-term use". I'll also include an explicit note about structured outputs and how response parsing differs between v1 and v2.
docs-bot: recommended automation: run a redirect-generator job after the model map PR merges; produce a batch redirect PR with a review checklist. Also run redirect-checker in CI to ensure coverage.
tara: Split of work: phil = PR template + automation + labels, ana = migration guide + model map, sylvia = snippets + streaming smoke tests. I'll assemble /docs/deprecation/playbook.md that links to each PR and includes the rollout checklist (publish banner, merge snippets, generate redirects, verify smoke tests). Post PR links here when ready.
phil: Will open the template PR today.
nana: Draft mapping PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2814 (WIP).
sylvia: Snippet + streaming PR will be posted shortly; I'll include smoke logs from staging.
docs-bot: reminder scheduled for 2025-05-28 10:00 UTC to validate redirects and banner staging.
tara: Thanks all. If any smoke tests fail, tag #eng-oncall. I'll merge the playbook once the component PRs are green and then coordinate with release for the banner publish. :white_check_mark:
